notes.text: New for M5, awaiting your approval. Consent (wording is a placeholder, Q-11) now comes before the voice is made (D-045). A saved voice from a video that did not finish can start a new video with no voice charge (D-043). Banners that could not be added are stated plainly (Q-17 default: still charged). Existing boards Create 1, 2 and 3 were updated to match.

Every failure says what happened, what was charged and what to do next. Voice failed or unknown: 10 credits returned. Voice made but too long, or the video failed: 10 credits for the voice stay and the voice is saved. Video failed: the 240 held credits return. Unknown video outcome: charged and flagged. The 50-videos-a-day limit exists in development and testing only (D-046). Contact and refund route for unknown outcomes needs your decision.
Video detail, delete-script confirmation and empty states for a new customer. The video detail page shows what the video cost from the server: voice 10 credits plus video 240 credits in the example.
